connector.name: MCP Office PowerPoint
connector.registryDescription: 46-tool PowerPoint MCP server. Build, edit, and export .pptx files. Windows-first.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-office. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dosev-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PPT_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS
env.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access. Required — no files are accessible without this.

env.name: PPT_ENABLE_WRITE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations (slide editing and shape creation).

env.name: PPT_ENABLE_COM
env.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: export_slide, export_deck, run_slide_show, recalculate_charts, export_changed_slides_only. Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft PowerPoint.
